summary: 27 features and 2 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • vscode-server: add session-level Code Server support (ae23b70)
  • vscode-server: add subPath parameter and workspace directory support (aafae94)
  • vscode-server: integrate VSCode Server into existing services (7ebecce)
  • vscode-server: add VSCode Server runtime support (0c0ecde)

HagiCode-org/web

  • guide: add manual replay functionality to conversation guide (0cc2c02)
  • guide: add element IDs for new user conversation guide targets (b9a2bb5)
  • vault: enhance Code Server integration (d8a4c78)
  • conversation: update conversation detail panel (20da3f4)
  • hooks: enhance project actions with repository labels (141febe)
  • project: enhance Code Server actions in project list (7c88788)
  • session: add Code Server quick actions (ebdc8ed)
  • git: improve repository selection with sorting (7203dfd)
  • i18n: add VSCode server launch history translations (fbfe694)
  • statusbar: enhance VSCode server status indicator (37b9ed3)
  • vscode: add launch history and session support (217eedc)
  • api: update generated API models and services (b67734c)
  • i18n: add VSCode server locale entries (045990b)
  • vscode: add VSCode server UI components (031bec9)
  • vscode: add VSCode server service and project actions (51d9cff)
  • signalr: enhance connection handling and test coverage (868ea23)
  • api: add VSCode server DTO models (e7c9969)
  • ui: update StatusBar and config panel for VSCode integration (ca9616f)
  • session: add recent conversation history to message input (77a7d5b)
  • vault: add Code Server integration and selection highlights (c7f417a)
  • project: add open in VSCode action to projects (a89d45b)
  • vscode: add VSCode server settings and status indicator (54e7f62)
  • api: update generated API models and services (9046662)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/web

  • kanban: sync game scene cards when progress data changes (a757c54)
  • driverjs: fix z-index stacking for floating UI layers (5e04133)
